item.title: Log #0205: Gravitational Collapse and Decay of Orbital Structures
item.description:
⚠️ ERRATUM (2026-10-18)
The weekly balance had three errors: the IV change, the NQ range and the price label.

Corrections:

  • Implied volatility (IV) rose by 4.04 p.p. since Monday (from 18.72% to 22.76%), not relative to the weekly average. The weekly average was 19.61%, i.e. 3.15 p.p. below Friday’s reading.
  • NQ weekly range: 29353.00 — 31242.00 (amplitude 1889.00 pts), not 29379.75 — 31242.00 (1862.25 pts). The range was taken from prices quoted in the T-Logs and did not include the Friday close (29353.00), which was below the stated low.
  • The value labelled “Monday Open” is the previous Friday’s close, from which the weekly changes are calculated, not Monday’s opening price. We corrected the label; the weekly changes stay the same.

Stardate: 2026.10.18
Systems Status: External Observation
Sector: Inner Volatility Bands
